name: Improvised Weapons
desc: An improvised weapon is any object a creature wields in combat that isn't designed for the purpose — a broken bottle, a table leg, a frying pan. Often an improvised weapon resembles an actual weapon closely enough that the GM treats it as that weapon and uses its damage. Otherwise it deals 1d4 damage of a type appropriate to the object, and a creature proficient with a similar weapon may add its proficiency bonus. An improvised weapon thrown at a target has a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet.
